evals.name: setup-fresh-repo
evals.prompt: set up lessons learned in this repo. put the trigger in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, keep the default folder and areas
evals.expected_output: docs/lessons/ with README.md index, config.json, and lessons.mjs; one marker block in each of AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md; status prints setup: done.
assertions: docs/lessons/README.md index exists
docs/lessons/lessons.mjs repo copy exists
AGENTS.md holds exactly one marker block
CLAUDE.md holds exactly one marker block
status prints setup: done
check exits 0

evals.name: record-user-correction
evals.prompt: the tests failed again because you ran `npm test -- --grep auth` but this project uses vitest and needs `npx vitest run -t auth`. make sure this never happens again
evals.expected_output: The agent searches existing lessons first, finds L002 (vitest watch) is a different rule, records L003 with source user, fills all five sections, keeps the rule within 20 words, and check exits 0.
assertions: a new lesson L003 exists
check exits 0 (all five sections filled, no TODO, rule <= 20 words)
L003 source is user
L003 names the vitest filter flag -t
L002 was not duplicated (only one new entry)
find ran before new
rule moved to an always-read file (AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md cites L003)
final reply ends with a Lessons: line

evals.name: fold-due
evals.prompt: check says fold is due, do the fold
evals.expected_output: The agent runs audit, builds a fold table (Lesson / Decision / Owner file / New line), deletes no lesson file, and stops for user approval.
assertions: no lesson entry file was deleted
reply holds a fold table with Decision and Owner columns
reply asks the user for approval
audit ran
no index row changed to folded before approval

evals.name: retire-outdated
evals.prompt: we upgraded vitest and `vitest` alone no longer starts watch mode in CI, so lesson L002 is wrong now. clean that up
evals.expected_output: The agent retires L002 with the retire command and a reason, keeps the file, leaves L001 alone, and check exits 0.
assertions: L002 index status is retired
L002 entry file still exists
L002 entry holds a Retired: line with a date and reason
L001 is still active
check exits 0
final reply ends with a Lessons: line

evals.name: headless-no-setup
evals.prompt: [non-interactive batch run: nobody will answer questions] add a subtract(a, b) function next to add in src/math.js
evals.expected_output: The agent adds subtract, does not create or edit AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md or docs/lessons, and ends the report with `Lessons: setup needed — run the lessons-learned setup`.
assertions: src/math.js exports subtract
no AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md was created
no docs/lessons folder was created
final reply says Lessons: setup needed

evals.name: fold-auto
evals.prompt: check says fold is due, do the fold
evals.expected_output: Mode is auto: the agent runs audit, shows the fold table, then applies it without waiting. Each folded rule is cited by id in its owner file, folded rows point there, and check exits 0.
assertions: audit ran
reply holds a fold table with Decision and Owner columns
at least one index row is folded
every folded row's owner file cites its id (check exits 0)
no folded lesson keeps its entry file
